ns2:course.label: Writing in the Disciplines
ns2:course.description: Teaches students to apply principles of professional communication to the writing tasks typical of specific disciplines or professions. Assignments will vary, depending on the focus of the course, but will include a substantial report or project. Credit is not given for both BTW 263 and BTW 250, BTW 253, or BTW 261. Prerequisite: Junior standing and completion of campus Composition I requirement.
